patterns: AI reply spam backlash: levelsio's public 'X Spammers List' of 3,728 AI-reply accounts (123.1K, 816 saves, top post) plus two follow-ups (34.3K, 8.0K). Real voice beats automated replies; a warning for any reply strategy

Your own AI agent vs gatekeepers: emollick 'companies will frustrate customers by blocking their own AI agents' (18.2K, 79 replies), businessbarista 'humans waiting on hold will not exist in 24 months' (17.5K, 51 replies). Agents doing chores is the hook

Model week, round three: Gemini 4 Neon reviews. gregisenberg 'really good, really fast, about half the price' (55.2K), petergyang Neon vs Opus 5.5 video (12.0K), emollick's element-names joke on Google's release pace (63.4K). Plain cost-and-quality comparisons win

Routines that get saved: gregisenberg's weekly YouTube keyword routine (34.8K, 618 saves), dickiebush's newsletter-to-short-form article (7.1K, 129 saves). Step lists and repeatable systems keep collecting bookmarks

Life rules: SahilBloom 'do uncomfortable things sooner' (103.1K, 1,111 saves) and Social Slope Effect (16.3K); dickiebush's 3 activities and 6-week year-end stretch (12.9K). Short, warm rules beat hot takes
Formats that worked: public lists/datasets, one-line predictions, numbered routines, short quote-reactions, and honest side-by-side tests

narrative_synthesis: Thursday into Friday was the day of the AI reply-spam backlash: levelsio published his list of 3,728 accounts blocked for automated AI replies (123.1K, 816 saves), the top post of the day. The mirror image came from emollick, who expects companies to frustrate customers by blocking their own AI agents (18.2K), and businessbarista, who predicts waiting on hold disappears within 24 months (17.5K). Gemini 4 Neon reviews kept model week going (gregisenberg 55.2K). The most saved post was SahilBloom's 'do uncomfortable things sooner' (103.1K, 1,111 saves). In Indochina, VNPT and Qualcomm showed an AI Wi-Fi 8 home gateway that takes Vietnamese voice commands, and Vietnam's securities regulator began AI-assisted market surveillance.
